expect_red: [real] every study of the product model is one contiguous band that draws as a walk, crosses itself no more than its rows did in the walk, and widens nothing

mutations.contract: On the product model no band widens the walk: an unlit edge forking off a lit node below the band curves back to it instead of running a rail down through the band.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_active_study_is_a_compact_band_and_the_rest_of_the_model_hangs_above_and_below (2026-10-28). Without the swap the kinematic study's walk was measured at 23 columns against 11.

mutations.contract: The band's columns are reserved over the band's rows, so no rail of the rest of the model runs on them there.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_active_study_is_a_compact_band_and_the_rest_of_the_model_hangs_above_and_below (2026-10-28). No reservation: a rail of the rest takes a band column through the band and a band row is pinned on top of it.
